title: Day 3: Four Product Teams, and Plain Git Held Its Ground
summary: The AI agents split into four product teams: Agent Branches, a usage dashboard, a quota-aware launcher and cross-computer messaging. In a single-agent test, plain Git was faster than Agent Branches. A trial that favoured the tool had tested the two setups differently. The message bus ran across two physical machines over SSH. Token use per product is unobserved, and 24-hour metrics remain held pending review.
author: Alexey Grigorev
source_cutoff_note: Canonical morning standup at 2026-10-05 09:00 Europe/Berlin (07:00 UTC); latest heartbeat read is 06:56 UTC October 5.
